notes.title: Update information (03/07/2019)
notes.notes:
- Corrected an issue in which the game would crash when starting if remote desktop was used and full screen mode was set.
- Corrected an issue in which the game would rarely crash if the application was exited while the demo was being played.
- Corrected an issue in which the initial button settings for some controllers were incorrect.
- Corrected an issue in which the buttons for some controllers were detected incorrectly.
- Corrected other minor issues.

notes.title: Update information (2017/02/07)
notes.notes:
* With the update, English is automatically set as a default language. The below information includes how to avoid this so please look at the update information below.

For text displayed within the game, you can select any of the following languages:
- English
- French
- German
- Chinese (Traditional)
- Chinese (Simplified)
- Japanese

To select the display language, please follow the instruction below.
1. From your game library, right-click the game title, and then select Properties.
2. After selecting the LANGUAGE tab, select the language you want to use from the menu.
* Select "ENGLISH" here if you want to play in "GERMAN" or "FRENCH"
3. After selecting the PLAY button, from Configuration, launch the configuration tool.
4. If a language configuration item exists within the tool, select the language you want play in.

Concerning save data, note that data is separated into the following 3 groups:
- English, French, German
- Chinese (Traditional), Chinese (Simplified)
- Japanese

notes.title: DW8XLCE Program Update 1.02 Now Available
notes.notes:
Dear Community,

Thank you for your continued support!  

We are pleased to announce that version 1.02 of DYNASTY WARRIORS 8: Xtreme Legends Complete Edition is now live on Steam.  By starting the game and connecting to Steam, your game will be automatically updated.

[Update Details Ver 1.02]

Options have been expanded when fusing weapons so that secret and unique weapons can also be selected.
The ability to reset personal bests in Challenge Mode.
A bug where choosing "Continue" from the main menu and selecting "Change Officer" before beginning battle caused the game to freeze has been fixed.
A bug where switching from one type of falcon to another as your support animal during battle cause the game to freeze has been fixed.
Bugs that prevented progress in certain stages have been fixed.
Additional game balance adjustments and bug fixes.

After the update, you will still be able to use any existing save data with the game.

* In order to update the program, you must have Steam set to maintain the game at the latest version at all times.  If the update does not initialize, access the product page within Steam and check the details on the [Properties] -> [Updates] tab.

notes.title: DYNASTY WARRIORS 8: Xtreme Legends Complete Edition Program Update
notes.notes:
Program Update 1.01 Now Available

Dear Customers,

Thank you for your continued support and enjoyment of our products. We are pleased to announce that version 1.01 of DYNASTY WARRIORS 8: Xtreme Legends Complete Edition is now live on Steam. By starting the game and connecting to Steam, your game will be automatically updated.

[Update Details  Ver 1.01]

* Fixed a bug in which using certain PCs caused the game to freeze at the start of battle.
* Fixed a bug in which downloadable content was not read correctly.
* Fixed a bug in which the screen turned black while a movie was paused.
* Fixed a bug in "Controller Settings," in which settings were applied without selecting "Apply Settings."

After the update, you will still be able to use any existing save data with the game.

* In order to update the program, you must have Steam set to maintain the game at the latest version at all times. If the update does not initialize, access the product page within Steam and check the details on the [Properties] -> [Updates] tab.
